request: The owner reported the tradeoff directly: "so the last version I asked you to pin has the visible tail but not the fixes and the latest version has the fixes and no visible tail", and asked to keep working on the blender addon to fix the missing tail and broken animations from pinned vpk versions noting traps.
findings: The model's bind skeleton dmx/mesh/shiv_tail15.dmx has 168 joints with root_motion orientation (0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5) and pelvis at top level, and it already carries tail_0..tail_end.
shiv_bind.vpk's skeleton matches that bind on all 168 joints at 0.0000u/0.00deg, tail joints included, so its rest is not why the tail vanished.
The pinned and bind skeletons have identical joint order (0 moved of 168); both differ from the model's own order on 147 joints, so order does not explain it either.
The remaining difference is that both builds ship a shiv.vnmskel_c at all, which replaces the model's skeleton; forge/animgraph.py already documents clips-only shipping as the design.
fixes: Built artifacts/oldviper/shiv_noskel.vpk from the owner's pinned clips with shiv.vnmskel_c and dmx/ removed: 95,944,787 bytes, sha256 462dc2d8, 266 files.
Installed it as pak97_dir.vpk on the D: Steam library.
Re-pinned tools/shiv_merge_gate.py to that build and replaced the bind-skeleton check with a clips-only check reading artifacts/receipts/release-clips-only.json.
Added two probes: skeleton_delta.py (distance and degrees per joint) and skeleton_order_compare.py (index order, which the rest probes cannot see).
Freed 3 GB of artifacts by deleting superseded 96 MB builds and extracted trees while keeping every gate-pinned vpk.
evidence: skeleton_delta.py: moved(>0.01u or >1deg)=4, all four are IK targets or sub-millimetre noise.
limits: The clips-only build has not been looked at in the loaded game yet; the owner is the only acceptance surface.
No explanation is measured for why the engine drops the tail when a vnmskel_c is shipped.
